# Data Loading
```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
Diabetes_path <- "../data/D003924_Diabetes_Mellitus,_T/species/phyloseq.RData"
ps <- get(load(Diabetes_path))
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
```

# Sample Filtering
```{r filter-samples}
sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

samples_to_keep <- sd %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  filter(if_all(c("Nr..reads.sequenced", "Host.age"), ~!is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(Sex %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

cat("Samples kept:", length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Samples removed:", nsamples(ps) - length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Country distribution:\n")
print(table(sd[samples_to_keep, "Country"]))
```

# Build Phyloseq Objects
```{r build-phyloseq, include=FALSE}
sample_data(ps)$keep <- sample_names(ps) %in% samples_to_keep
ps_clean <- subset_samples(ps, keep == TRUE)
sample_data(ps_clean)$keep <- NULL
sample_data(ps)$keep <- NULL
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_clean) > 0, ps_clean)

# Add readable labels
sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease <- ifelse(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease.MESH.ID == "D003924", "T2D", "Healthy"
)
sample_data(ps_clean)$Continent <- case_when(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Country == "China" ~ "Asia",
  TRUE ~ "Europe"
)

# Transformations
ps_rel_cleaned <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa_cleaned  <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
ps_clr <- microbiome::transform(
  transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) x + 1),  # add pseudocount first
  transform = "clr"
)

# Subsets
ps_t2d        <- subset_samples(ps_clean, Disease == "T2D")
ps_t2d_female <- subset_samples(ps_t2d, Sex == "Female")

cat("T2D samples by continent:\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_t2d)$Continent))
cat("T2D female samples by continent:\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_t2d_female)$Continent))
```

```{r disease-distribution}
sample_data(ps_clean) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  count(Disease, Continent) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Continent, y = n, fill = Disease)) +

  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),

  labs(title = "Distribution of T2D and Healthy samples",
       x = "Continent", y = "Number of samples", fill = "Disease") +
  theme_bw()
```

# Distances
```{r distances, include=FALSE}
bray_dist    <- distance(ps_rel_cleaned, method = "bray")
jaccard_dist <- distance(ps_pa_cleaned,  method = "jaccard")
```

# Alpha Diversity
```{r alpha-diversity}
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(ps_clean, measures = "Shannon") %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    as(sample_data(ps_clean), "data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Sex, data = alpha_div)
kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Country, data = alpha_div)
cor.test(alpha_div$Shannon, alpha_div$Host.age, method = "spearman")
```

# Beta Diversity

```{r pcoa-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ord_bray <- ordinate(ps_rel_cleaned, method = "PCoA", distance = bray_dist)

plot_ordination(ps_rel_cleaned, ord_bray, type = "samples",
                color = "Country", shape = "Sex") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r pcoa-clr, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# Aitchison distance = CLR + Euclidean (correct combination)
aitchison_dist <- distance(ps_clr, method = "euclidean")
ord_aitchison  <- ordinate(ps_clr, method = "PCoA", distance = aitchison_dist)

plot_ordination(ps_clr, ord_aitchison, type = "samples",
                color = "Disease", shape = "Continent") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "PCoA — Aitchison distance (CLR + Euclidean)")
```

## RDA
```{r rda-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# ── Change dataset here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
rda_data <- ps_t2d_female
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 1. CLR-transformed OTU matrix
rda_clr <- microbiome::transform(rda_data, "clr")
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_table(rda_clr))
if (taxa_are_rows(rda_clr)) otu_clr <- t(otu_clr)
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_clr)

# 2. Metadata
meta_rda <- sample_data(rda_data) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  select(Continent, Host.age, Nr..reads.sequenced) %>%
  mutate(
    Host.age            = scale(Host.age),
    Nr..reads.sequenced = scale(Nr..reads.sequenced),
    Continent           = as.factor(Continent)
  )

# 3. RDA
rda_result <- rda(otu_clr ~ Continent + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced,
                  data = meta_rda)

# 4. Variance explained
eig  <- rda_result$CCA$eig
pct1 <- round(eig[1] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)
pct2 <- round(eig[2] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)

# 5. Site scores + metadata
site_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    sample_data(rda_data) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# 6a. Biplot arrows
biplot_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "bp") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

site_range  <- max(abs(c(site_scores$RDA1, site_scores$RDA2)))
arrow_scale <- site_range * 0.8 /
  max(sqrt(biplot_scores$RDA1^2 + biplot_scores$RDA2^2))
biplot_scores <- biplot_scores %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * arrow_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * arrow_scale)

# 6b. Top species scores
tax_df <- tax_table(rda_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  mutate(across(-taxon, ~str_remove(., "^[a-z]__")))

species_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "species") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "taxon") %>%
  mutate(label = Species)

top_species <- species_scores %>%
  mutate(importance = sqrt(RDA1^2 + RDA2^2)) %>%
  slice_max(importance, n = 10)

species_scale <- site_range * 0.6 /
  max(sqrt(top_species$RDA1^2 + top_species$RDA2^2))
top_species <- top_species %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * species_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * species_scale)

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = Continent),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = biplot_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = biplot_scores,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = variable),
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = top_species,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = top_species,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = label),
            size = 2.5, color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Asia" = "#E74C3C", "Europe" = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = "RDA: gut microbiome constrained by Continent, Age & Read depth",
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", pct1, "% of total variance)"),
    y = paste0("RDA2 (", pct2, "% of total variance)"),
    color = "Continent"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# Differential Abundance
```{r continent-differential, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

rank_depth <- "Species"

clr_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(microbiome::transform(rda_data, "clr")))
if (taxa_are_rows(rda_data)) clr_mat <- t(clr_mat)

meta <- sample_data(rda_data) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

# Include all three variables in clr_long
clr_long <- clr_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "clr") %>%
  left_join(meta %>% select(SampleID, Continent, Host.age, Nr..reads.sequenced),
            by = "SampleID") %>%
  left_join(tax_df %>% select(taxon, all_of(rank_depth)), by = "taxon")

# Wilcoxon — tests Continent only (non-parametric, cannot include covariates)
# Residualise clr against Host.age and Nr..reads.sequenced first
clr_long <- clr_long %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  mutate(clr_resid = residuals(lm(clr ~ Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced))) %>%
  ungroup()

results <- clr_long %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(rank_depth))) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_Asia   = mean(clr_resid[Continent == "Asia"],   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Europe = mean(clr_resid[Continent == "Europe"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value     = wilcox.test(
      clr_resid[Continent == "Asia"],
      clr_resid[Continent == "Europe"]
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj       = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    log2FC      = mean_Asia - mean_Europe,
    significant = p_adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

ggplot(results, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(data = results %>% filter(significant) %>% slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 15),
            aes(label = .data[[rank_depth]]),
            size = 2.5, hjust = -0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#E74C3C")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Wilcoxon differential abundance at", rank_depth, "level"),
    subtitle = "CLR residualised against Host.age and Nr..reads.sequenced",
    x = "CLR residual difference (Asia - Europe)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Significant\n(BH adj. p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

cat("Wilcoxon significant taxa (adj. p < 0.05):", sum(results$significant), "\n")
```

```{r glm-differential, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(broom)

set.seed(42)
glm_results <- clr_long %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(rank_depth))) %>%
  do(tidy(glm(clr ~ Continent + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced,
              data = ., family = gaussian()))) %>%
  filter(term == "ContinentEurope") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj       = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    log2FC      = estimate
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

cat("GLM significant taxa (adj. p < 0.05):", sum(glm_results$significant), "\n")

ggplot(glm_results, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(data = glm_results %>% filter(significant) %>% slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 15),
            aes(label = .data[[rank_depth]]),
            size = 2.5, hjust = -0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#E74C3C")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("GLM differential abundance at", rank_depth, "level"),
    subtitle = "Controlling for Host.age and Nr..reads.sequenced",
    x = "GLM estimate (Asia - Europe)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Significant\n(BH adj. p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

cat("\nIn both tests:\n")
print(intersect(
  results %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(rank_depth),
  glm_results %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(rank_depth)
))

cat("\nIn Wilcoxon only:\n")
print(setdiff(
  results %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(rank_depth),
  glm_results %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(rank_depth)
))

cat("\nIn GLM only:\n")
print(setdiff(
  glm_results %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(rank_depth),
  results %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(rank_depth)
))
```

```{r both-significant-species-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

)

  filter(.data[[rank_depth]] %in% both_sig) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FC > 0, "Higher in Asia", "Higher in Europe"))

                                "Higher in Europe" = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Taxa significant in both Wilcoxon and GLM at", rank_depth, "level"),
    x = "GLM estimate (Asia - Europe)",

  ) +

cat("Taxa significant in both tests:", length(both_sig), "\n")
```

```{r test-comparison-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Combine results from both tests
wilcox_sig <- results %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  pull(.data[[rank_depth]])

glm_sig <- glm_results %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  pull(.data[[rank_depth]])

# Create comparison dataframe
all_taxa <- union(wilcox_sig, glm_sig)

comparison_df <- tibble(
  taxon = all_taxa,
  Wilcoxon = all_taxa %in% wilcox_sig,
  GLM      = all_taxa %in% glm_sig
) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      Wilcoxon & GLM  ~ "Both",
      Wilcoxon & !GLM ~ "Wilcoxon only",
      !Wilcoxon & GLM ~ "GLM only"
    )
  )

# Summary bar plot
comparison_df %>%
  count(category) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = category, y = n, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Both"          = "#2ECC71",
    "Wilcoxon only" = "#E74C3C",
    "GLM only"      = "#3498DB"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant taxa by test",
    x = NULL, y = "Number of taxa", fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r significant-tax-tree}
# Get significant taxon IDs
sig_taxa <- clr_long %>%
  left_join(results %>% filter(significant), by = rank_depth) %>%
  filter(significant == TRUE) %>%
  pull(taxon) %>%
  unique()

# Extract full taxonomy for significant taxa
tax_table(rda_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  filter(taxon %in% sig_taxa) %>%
  mutate(across(-taxon, ~str_remove(., "^[a-z]__"))) %>%
  select(Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Taxonomic tree of significant taxa")
```
